title: The Universe of Universes: Benefit Yield Functions, Implosion Thresholds, and Infrastructure-Aware Optimization in Multi-LLM Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.15314v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce the Universe of Universes (UoU) framework, which treats the full ecosystem of major large language models (LLMs) as a structured retrieval corpus and proposes a compositional Automated Reasoning (AR) and Machine Learning (ML) architecture for cross-model retrieval-augmented generation. The central contribution is the formal characterization of the Benefit Yield Function (BYF), the marginal performance gain per additional model added to an ensemble, and the identification of the implosion threshold {\theta}*: the ensemble size at which BYF crosses zero and aggregate performance begins to degrade. Existing LLM ensemble and mixture-of-agents systems treat models as responders and aggregate outputs, but do not study performance as a function of ensemble size N across the full model universe. translated_title: 宇宙中的宇宙：多LLM系统中的收益函数、内爆阈值与基础设施感知优化
translated_abstract: 我们提出了宇宙中的宇宙（UoU）框架，该框架将主要大型语言模型（LLM）的完整生态系统视为一个结构化检索语料库，并提出了一种用于跨模型检索增强生成的自动推理（AR）与机器学习（ML）的组合式架构。核心贡献是对收益函数的形式化刻画，即向集成系统中每增加一个模型所带来的边际性能增益，并识别出内爆阈值θ*：即BYF降至零以下、总体性能开始退化的集成规模。现有的LLM集成和智能体混合系统将模型视为响应者并聚合其输出，但并未将性能作为整个模型宇宙中集成规模N的函数加以研究。基准测试研究证实了单个模型层面存在性能平台期；模型崩溃文献则确立了迭代训练……
tldr: 该论文提出UoU框架，将所有主要大语言模型视为结构化检索语料库，通过形式化定义收益函数（BYF）和内爆阈值θ*，刻画了模型集成性能随集成规模变化的规律，为多LLM系统实现基础设施感知的优化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Universe of Universes (UoU) framework, which treats major LLMs as a structured retrieval corpus and formally characterizes the Benefit Yield Function and the implosion threshold θ*, enabling infrastructure-aware optimization of multi-LLM ensemble performance as a function of ensemble size.
